identity._comment: Who Ethan is when it acts. It uses only its own accounts: the bridge app, the harness agent id, the Telegram bot. owner is written here or in ETHAN_OWNER, never guessed. agent_id is what the harness records for Ethan's launches.
identity.name: Ethan

reach._comment: When something also goes to your phone (the Telegram door): always when urgent; otherwise only when you have not typed for away_after_min and it is not quiet hours.

claude.note: Max plan; edits auto-accepted, arbitrary bash still restricted

codex.note: exec is non-interactive: no --ask-for-approval flag exists (verified codex-cli 0.149.0)

sky._comment: Ethan starts hands through core's `sky build`. bin: path to core/bin/sky (else $SKY_BIN, else PATH). policy: plugin/policy.yaml (else $SKY_POLICY, else the installed plugin). state_dir: where core writes run records (default state/sky). agent_id: passed as SKY_AGENT_ID.
